trailhead.label: The park car park and picnic area at Sant’Apollonia, Ponte di Legno, the published start

cautions: The first 0.7 km is a tarmac lane open to cars: keep your dog on a short lead.
The farm road serves summer farms and pastures: expect cows and farm vehicles, and keep your dog close.
The last stretch to the hut is steeper: let your dog set the pace.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
